messages:
Carmen (People Ops): Quick note 30n update to the Handbook: 'Hybrid Work & Sensitive Data' posted this morning. Weve also assigned a brief refresher training for anyone with file-system or customer-data access. Please complete by Dec 1. Link: https://redwood.internal/handbook/hybrid-sensitive.

Jules (Talent): Do contractors get assigned this too? We have a batch starting next week.

Carmen (People Ops): Contractors on SOW >= 30 days or those with data access will be assigned. Short-term vendors excluded unless they touch customer data; recruiting, please tag SOWs accordingly.

Ravi (Engineering): For our team, can managers request a bulk extension for folks on parental leave?

Carmen (People Ops): Yes, managers must file an HR ticket with start/end dates; extensions are logged for audit. Use HR Ticket Bot or hr.redwood/ticket.

Marta (Legal): Audit reminder: exports must include user, module_id, completion_ts, manager_id, and IP. People Ops please run the export after the deadline and archive to compliance-s3 with two-year retention.

LMS Bot: automated: Module assigned: "Hybrid Work & Data Refresher (2026)" to 278 users. Due: 1780396800 (Dec 1 2026). Progress: 0%. Link: https://lms.redwood.internal/course/hybrid-data-2026

Jules (Talent): Can we get a manager-facing CSV so leads can track completions per team?

Carmen (People Ops): Created manager tracking sheet (edit access): https://sheets.redwood.internal/hybrid-data-2026. Paste header to import:

``
manager,employee_email,employee_id,status,completed_at,extension_ticket,notes
``

Ravi (Engineering): Will prior completions count? I completed a similar course in Jan.

Carmen (People Ops): If the module matches within 12 months, mark as 'completed' with the prior completion date and add certificate link in notes. Well validate when exporting.

HR Ticket Bot: automated: Reminder: managers must certify training status before submitting Q1 calibration packets. Certification field added to manager packet form.

Marta (Legal): Also ensure managers keep a documented copy of approvals for 2 years. We'll request ticket IDs in the export.

Carmen (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll post a short announcement in #all-hands and follow up with a report one week before the deadline. Ping me for bulk exemptions. :thumbsup:
